as_told.title: Jesse smells sulfur on his ranch visit; gas monitor reads nothing

plain: Michels says that on a visit to Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, he smelled sulfur and thought "I got to get the hell out of here." He tells it as his own experience, around 2022, to a former Pentagon official named Lue Elizondo and on other episodes, once adding a dark month that followed the visit. On a later episode he adds that a gas monitor picked up nothing and puts the smell down to a "dragon", which would make the smell a sign of something present there rather than ordinary gas.
